items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I think he was 39 then... I think I'm a little bit older than Jack Benny was.

ctx.x: And of course later on came Jack Benny to throw in the [jester gesture.] I don't remember when he started, it seems as though he's been going as long as I can remember too. And I think he was 39 then.
